title: Plithgoenic Fuzzy Risk Management and Plithgoenic Fuzzy IT Service Management
content: Plithogenic sets represent elements through attribute–driven memberships together with a contradiction map over attribute values [1–3]. Upside-Down Logic reverses truth and falsity under a structured transformation, flipping evaluations while preserving internal consistency across logical contexts. Risk management is the process of identifying, assessing, and mitigating potential losses to minimize the impact on organizational objectives [4–6]. IT service management (ITSM) is the process of designing, delivering, managing, and improving IT services to meet business needs effectively, efficiently, and consistently [7–9]. In this paper, we formally introduce Plithogenic Fuzzy Risk Management and Plithogenic Fuzzy IT Service Management and investigate their structural properties.
